desc:
✨ Welcome to PreCure! All Stars!

Play as your favourite Cure and battle or role-play with your friends!

💖  NOTE:
- This game is on its BETA phase.
- You can say ;chibi to become kawaii :3 
- Testing is open. Have fun!

🌸  UPDATES:
- Slightly redesigned the character-selection screen

PreCure/Pretty Cure/プリキュア/Glitter Force Universe based game.
